snippet.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Ex Umbra Preview Video
snippet.description:
GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Ex Umbra

Time-Limited Event [Ex Umbra] will be open from August 14. During the event, Commanders can receive generous rewards including [Collapse Pieces], [Targeted Access Permissions], [Basic Info Cores] by participating in event Game Modes.

[Duration] 
2025/8/14 09:00 ~ 2025/9/3 18:59(GMT+0)
The event shop exchange will expire at 2025/9/10 18:59(GMT+0)

[Unlock Conditions] 
Commander Level 20
